newCandidatesThisWeek.rationale: 60%+ of mobile YouTube Shorts views happen with sound off — this tool auto-burns synchronized captions onto the hook and key spoken moments for sound-off legibility. Distinct from edit_text_overlay_hook (which places a static opening text card) — this is a dynamic caption-burn pass synchronized to spoken audio throughout the clip.

70%+ average percentage viewed is the new benchmark threshold for algorithm-promoted Shorts; below 50% signals a hook or pacing failure. This is an audit-and-flag tool that identifies which segments fall below the retention threshold and proposes cut-point interventions — different from existing pacing tools which apply cuts uniformly without measuring retention impact.

Frame-precise 2–2.5 second hook window enforcement: analyzes the opening of a clip and flags or trims any element that extends the spoken hook beyond frame 60-72 (at 24fps). Distinct from existing hook tools which target content rather than enforcing timing constraints at the frame level.

Comedy reveal structure for hunting TikTok: reaction shot or comedic moment placed at open, followed by setup context and punchline payoff — a specific sequencing template for humor-first outdoor content (deer ignoring bait, missed shots, bloopers). Distinct from edit_reaction_reveal_cut which uses the reaction-reveal structure for genuine hunt moments rather than comedy.

Places the highest-tension moment (close-range shot, animal encounter, reaction) at the clip open with no setup context, then provides setup mid-clip via text card — achieves 'Would you be shaking' hook impact. Distinct from hunt_comedy_reveal (humorous) and reaction_reveal_cut (chronological reveal) in that it deliberately reorders the most tension-peak frame to the first 1-2 seconds.

Step-by-step numbered text overlay for utility how-to Reels (binocular choice, hunting blind tips, camo layering) — a structured instructional caption template that generates Step 1 / Step 2 / Step 3 overlays synced to spoken beats. Different from edit_caption_hook_overlay (single payoff line at open) in providing multi-beat instructional scaffolding throughout the clip.

Raw field-use export preset for hunt collaboration Reels: minimal color correction, natural ambient audio preserved, no music, no graphic elements — signals authentic in-field content. Distinct from edit_authentic_raw_cut (TikTok deliberate no-edit style) in being specifically tuned for Instagram Reels export dimensions and the hunting-brand collaboration format (gear-in-use framing, no product isolation).

LinkedIn-specific 15-60 second clip formatter: enforces vertical 9:16 crop, duration trim to the 15-60s sweet spot, adds native-upload-safe encoding settings, and strips or adjusts elements that underperform on LinkedIn (music, flashy transitions, TikTok/Reels watermarks). Distinct from edit_reformat_for_linkedin (layout-only crop) in enforcing the duration constraint and LinkedIn-specific encoding.

Long-form to LinkedIn short-clip splitter: takes a webinar, field video, or long-form hunt documentary and identifies 15-60 second extractable clips with standalone context, adds intro/context text card to each, and exports a LinkedIn-ready clip set. A new multi-clip extraction workflow distinct from single-clip LinkedIn formatting tools.

CTA endcard insert addressing the 12% short-form LinkedIn conversion rate: adds a final 3-5 second endcard with a text CTA (link, comment prompt, or longer-video invite) synchronized to a spoken CTA line. Distinct from edit_linkedin_short_clip_formatter in operating at the end of the clip specifically to bridge the conversion gap identified in LinkedIn short-form analytics.
